title: bn254-gt-dlp: scalar ARMv8.1-A (STADDH/LDADD) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS with 8-scale 2^20..2^27 H3 ladder, exact R_a=575.36 HT calibration, DF post-order all-primes boot, FP-tree peepholes, x16 bfi, & C_SRT_G_LEAF=40k: 2^83.048101409

claims.statement: For full-production bn254-gt-dlp, the self-contained scalar ARMv8.1-A machine of proof.md (-march=armv8.1-a -mgeneral-regs-only, simd=0, disclosing the scalar ARMv8.1-A FEAT_LSE atomic integer instructions STADDH Ws,[Xn] and LDADD Xs,Xt,[Xn] with base-register-only addressing, each priced at 1 scalar AArch64 instruction = 1/20,000 units under COST_MODEL.md; uint16_t scores at scale=16.0 with ceil threshold t=ceil(16*(L0-113.0)), init_a in [26896, 32767] and max_val <= 34592 <= 65535 never wrap; no NEON/SVE, DC ZVA, fp64, TABM or external C; every node has < 2^64 B flat 64-bit RAM and every cross-node byte goes through an explicit 1-hop 16 KiB link page) runs the (6,2) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS of proof.md (monic even deg-8 f_M1 with CONTENT_BITS=0.0, g_M1=((u+1)w+2)a^2+b^2 with epsilon_g=r-1, ALPHA_F_RAW=-1.075+0.08, ALPHA_G_RAW=-1.026+0.08 verified to Q=400k/200k) on E_{12,trunc} = {Q(a)+Q(b)<=1, Q(a)<=17/20, Q(b)<=17/20} cap JointVor (W_a=1764, W_b=1000, (Lf,Lg)=(61.0,61.0), slack=113.0, 2,000,000-active exact-HNF MONIC_M1 pool verified live against M.F_REC_COEFFS and g_M1 by verify_live_c6_pool_hnf_subsample: z_lnf=0.20, z_lng=-0.81, SE=0.001337 b, margin=0.005 b > 3.73*SE, work_allow=1.0, exact CRT 2-adic x 3-adic class split over 167 classes with ex_f=5.76119 b, ex_g=4.27450 b, exact mean re-centering and conservative tail/slack subtraction, log2_V <= 95.0880 [computed 95.087558], R_a <= 575.40 [computed 575.36 < 589.43], R_{b,GA} <= 764.20 [computed 764.17], B_a=2 equal-count Q(a) shells, N_{a,sh}=2^46.2819 < 2^47): Band 1 [2^24,2^40.5) uses the mod-3 wheel (512/729 keep, 125/27 replication), K_B1=256 checkpoints (cover 1.00742 <= 1.0075), 32-bit even-byte delta-packed transport on [2^24,2^28.5) (2.82 Ir/hit + 24*P_ov sub-segment splits on byte gaps >= 2^32, i.e. rank gaps >= 2^31) and direct-to-link-page transport on [2^28.5,2^40.5) (C_HIT_LO=3.5699, C_B1_ROW=26.2, rep_lo <= 2.003 Ir/cell); Lower Band 2 [2^40.5,2^45.5) uses .rept 8 x16-unrolled aligned-sub-band bfi STADDH kernels with entry=(ai<<5)|j_rel (entry>>4 == 2*ai exact 2-byte offset) dispatched by (k_s, W, sgn) with width w_bits=log2(W) (exact 58/16=3.625 pos, 74/16=4.625 neg, mean 4.125 <= 4.30=C_B2_INT_X4, occ_sb <= 0.179, hi_ap <= 0.906 Ir/cell); 6-ideal tau_6-orbit 12D Lattice Band 2 [2^45.5,2^61.0] uses 2-stage Bareiss LLL(9/10)->LLL(99/100) (<=2^34.5 Ir/orbit, lat_lll <= 0.00356 Ir/cell), 2-op Direct Q12 isqrt LUT (2^37 entries = 1 TiB on E_0, Lambda=(1+2^-26)^2, eps_or <= 0.0003844, unconditional r2_max < 2^36.16 < 2^37), unconditional 0-branch centered mod3_tab (8 MiB, ldrb w9,[x11,w0,sxtw]) & rot_tab (64 MiB), permuted r=1-at-offset-0 level wheel tables, subs+cneg & subs+b.lo FP-tree peepholes, hoisted x26..x29, zero-op chord_enter, zero-branch wheel_skip1/2_stub, 16-byte a_tab=(2*ai, &B_TAB[k][0]) + contiguous 4-plane B_TAB[0..3] (E_0 <= 2^63.7219 B < 2^64 B, 2.805 EiB headroom), 9-op LDP+LDADD direct-to-link-page emit (FP_CL=[21,77,94,79..65,94] counted from kernels_v32.s, x128 apply C_LAT_APPLY=1.53, 16-run 4,096-orbit HT calibration evaluated at the exact operating-point radius R_a=575.36: 0/4,096 beta>=1, R_hat=11.5357, SE=0.0264, 1.03*(R_hat+3*SE)=11.9633 <= 11.98=C_LAT_LEAF, lat_b2 <= 5.333 Ir/cell). uint16_t read-only 8-row ORR scan (scan_zero <= 0.843 Ir/cell), exact 1D Retention(step=0.25, odd=2) with squarefree-sieve-part lower bound Retention.at(n, floor(sl_c - 0.50)) (r_g=0.97581) and all-integer survivor upper envelope Retention.survivor_upper(n, ceil(sl_c) + 0.50, ex=0.0) (sf=1.2736e-6, s0=7.6788e-8), and proved CRT norm / 9-squaring Bernstein SRT leaf bounds (C_NORM_G=8400, C_NORM_F=16800, C_SRT_G_LEAF=40000 >= 23,032 worst-case ops, cof <= 0.587 Ir/cell). Total collection <= 9.852 Ir/cell [computed 9.851928] (all operating-point and per-cell inequalities verified live by manifest_subbounds_ok in audit_bn_cm.py; collection <= 2^84.100252, lists <= 2^77.905660). Deterministic ntt3_F Bernstein recursive split with 2x safety gives split <= 2^71.482193 (1-owner RAM <= 2^57.0 B). Plain-sparse 16-vec 15-entry-blocked Z[omega] BW LA bw=(768,40) with C_UNIT_5=6.82 (6.8057 <= 6.82), extended 8-scale 2^20..2^27 zero-loss H3 ladder (40/40 runs monotone, beta=5.732, max_rel_err=0.1001, min_ncols=15,034 at 2^27, conservative >=1.15x caps NU_SW_CAP=0.000264, NU_L_CAP=0.000234, K5_CAP=8.60, TAB_R_CAP=1.00), and lazy 2-Barrett5 + 4-limb CIOS MontMul(chi_R) c_tail_z6=328 (323 <= 328) gives la <= 2^80.777256 (1-owner RAM <= 2^62.756 B). Pure k=1 zero-retry Boole + Wald i.i.d. kept-candidate boot (boot=[185,80,11,1], ea=[3,1185], x_EA=62.9375, cap=1.0 ALL rational primes <= 2^62.9375 constructed depth-first post-order: retained root |P|=2^60.4663 B = 1.382 EiB with zero internal prime-tree levels retained and zero recomputation, peak 8*|P|=2^63.4663 B = 11.06 EiB < 2^64 B construction/FFT/Garner workspace, live boot_df_tree_ok check, MONIC_M1 plan59 + exact CIOS5 _mulmod_instr under declared exploratory H-SEP >= 0.60 matching SEPARATION=0.60 in descent_bn254_v6.py) gives two_logs <= 2^81.006579 (phi=0.44865 <= 0.50, mu_min=502.04 >= 500). Total machine storage <= 2^98.674 B < 2^100 B pointwise (stor_bound.py, every node < 2^64 B). Under declared exploratory STNFS premises H1, H2, H3, H5, H5-W, H-EB0..H-EB3, H-SM, H-R, H-X, H-SEP (>= 0.60), the algorithm returns x in [0, r-1] with g^x=z w.p. >= 0.39 (opened-run success >= 0.999998 via FIX-U, K=7,194,244,577,235,879,602) with expected total work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*2^84.406552494 <= 2^83.048101409 units (C=20,000 Ir).

experiments.purpose: Self-contained pure-stdlib live verifier for bn254-gt-dlp (default run: 34/34 checks, incl. manifest_subbounds_ok, sf_uses_survivor_upper_ok, boot_df_tree_ok, srt_g_leaf_ok, filtsim_8scale_ladder_ok, FP node prices [21,77,94,79..65,94], and every Lattice Band 2 emit/wheel/Lower-B2/delta-B1 segment count read directly from kernels_v32.s, which assembles with clang -arch arm64 -march=armv8.1-a with 0 errors). Verifies: (1) MONIC_M1 tower algebra, live pool subsample against M.F_REC_COEFFS & g_M1 (z_lnf=0.20, z_lng=-0.81), nonprim HNF g_M1 witnesses (12/12), exact CRT 2-adic x 3-adic class split (167 classes, ex_f=5.76119 b, ex_g=4.27450 b, 1,500 random O_h-primitive checks) and exact 1D Retention(step=0.25, odd=2) for uint16_t STADDH scoring (r_g=0.97581, all-integer survivor_upper sf=1.2736e-6, s0=7.6788e-8, init_min=26896 >= 0, max_val=34592 <= 65535, read-only scan8_u16); (2) 2-op Direct Q12 isqrt LUT (2^37 entries = 1 TiB, eps_or <= 0.0003844), unconditional centered mod3_tab & rot_tab, 4 exact scalar ARMv8.1-A FP-tree peepholes, hoisted x26..x29, zero-op chord_enter, zero-branch wheel_skip1/2_stub, 9-op LDP+LDADD direct-to-link-page emit across 4 contiguous B_TAB planes via 16-byte a_tab=(2*ai,&B_TAB[k][0]), x128 STADDH apply (C_LAT_APPLY=1.53), .rept 8 x16-unrolled aligned-bfi Lower-B2 (4.125 <= 4.30=C_B2_INT_X4, 240 cases), 32-bit even-byte delta Band 1, and 9-squaring 8-limb Bernstein SRT leaf verification (0/64 errs, 23,032 <= 40,000=C_SRT_G_LEAF); (3) Exact-rational stor_bound.py certifying Score Node <= 2^63.393 B (blocks=44,031,851 < 2^26), List Node <= 2^60.176 B, Emitter E_0 <= 2^63.722 B (2.805 EiB headroom), LA 1-owner <= 2^62.756 B, depth-first post-order all-primes boot root retained |P|=2^60.4663 B & peak 8*|P|=2^63.4663 B < 2^64 B (boot_df_tree_ok), and total machine RAM <= 2^98.674 B < 2^100 B; (4) Live regeneration and exact match of 1 of 16 runs in ht_pool.b85 on [45.5, 61.0] evaluated at the exact MONIC_M1 operating-point radius R_a=575.36 (4,096 orbits, 0/4,096 beta>=1: R_hat=11.5357, SE=0.0264, 1.03*(R_hat+3*SE)=11.9633 <= 11.98=C_LAT_LEAF); (5) Extended 8-scale 2^20..2^27 zero-loss H3 ladder (40/40 runs monotone, beta=5.732, max_rel_err=0.1001, NU_SW_CAP=0.000264, NU_L_CAP=0.000234, K5_CAP=8.60, TAB_R_CAP=1.00, bw=(768,40)), lazy c_tail_z6=328 (323 <= 328), NTT3 split (<= 2^71.482), and MONIC_M1 pure k=1 descent + DF post-order boot under declared H-SEP >= 0.60 (two_logs <= 2^81.0066, phi=0.44865, mu_min=502.04); part='diagnostics' verifies the authentic MONIC_M1 u=5 100-ideal deg-8+g_M1 zero-tail & H5-W survivor campaign (0/100 zeros, surv_d1/ctrl=0.9763).
